summary: Backend-only testing for GatherSpace event management app. All 37 pytest cases PASSED (100%). Covered auth (register/login/me + duplicate + wrong pw), event listing with geo/radius/category filters, event CRUD with organizer ownership checks, 403 role-based access control (consumer cannot create/see organizer views, organizer cannot book), all 3 booking types (seat_map, general, time_slot), negative flows (double-book seat, over-capacity general, double-book time-slot), booking cancellation, and organizer analytics (revenue/tickets/events/attendees/per_event/category_breakdown). Seed script works and produces 5 events + 2 demo users. Minor non-blocking passlib bcrypt warning ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') printed to stderr but does not affect functionality.

minor.issue: Passlib emits 'error reading bcrypt version' warning at import time due to bcrypt>=4 removing __about__. Functionally fine (hashing/verify work), but noisy in logs. Consider pinning bcrypt<4 or upgrading passlib.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Silence bcrypt version warning by pinning bcrypt<4 in requirements.txt or upgrading passlib.

Consider adding validation for booking_type-specific fields at event creation (e.g., require seat_rows/seat_cols when booking_type=seat_map, total_seats for general, time_slots for time_slot). Currently the API accepts an incomplete config and enforces only at booking time.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seat_map booking does not validate seats against seat_rows*seat_cols grid — a consumer could book seat 'Z99' on a 5x6 grid and it would succeed.
server.py: booking_count is decremented never on cancel — total_tickets in analytics correctly recomputes from bookings, but the event.booked_count field on events will drift after cancellations.
server.py: EventCreate has no validators to ensure the fields required for each booking_type are present (see action item).
server.py: /api/bookings/{id}/cancel returns 404 if user doesn't own booking — good, but no check that the event hasn't already occurred.
server.py: SECRET_KEY falls back to a hardcoded dev key when JWT_SECRET_KEY env is missing — acceptable for dev, but flag for prod.
seed_data_creation: Ran `python /app/backend/seed.py` which wipes and re-inserts 2 demo users (demo@consumer.com, demo@organizer.com / password123) plus 5 events near SF (37.7749,-122.4194). Re-seeded after tests to restore clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints all verified. When testing frontend, use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Demo creds: demo@consumer.com / password123 (consumer), demo@organizer.com / password123 (organizer). Seeded events are around SF (37.7749,-122.4194); use radius_km>=5 to see all 5. Seat validation is not strict (any seat label works) — take that into account. Booking types: seat_map needs 'seats':['A1',...]; general needs 'num_seats':N; time_slot needs 'time_slot':'label'. Re-run `python /app/backend/seed.py` before frontend testing to reset state.
